title: The Ball That Would Not Fly Straight
coreQuestion: Why was the 2010 Jabulani ball criticised for its flight?

facts.claim: The Jabulani was the official match ball for the 2010 FIFA World Cup.
The ball is made from eight spherically moulded panels with a textured surface.
Professional players criticised the ball for poor performance.
A NASA aerospace engineer described its unpredictable behaviour as a knuckle-ball effect.

narration.text: The 2010 World Cup ball had players complaining.
Just eight moulded panels, with a textured surface.
Professional players criticised how it performed.
A NASA engineer described its unpredictable flight as a knuckle-ball effect.
A ball's surface can change its flight. Every goal has a story.
